cards.front: Cuando viajaba de mochilero por Asia las arañas que correteaban por mi almohada no me dejaban dormir en toda la noche.
cards.back: When I went backpacking in Asia spiders crawling over my pillow kept me awake all night.

cards.front: La gente que estaba de fiesta en la sala de reuniones tampoco me dejaba dormir en toda la noche.
cards.back: People partying in the meeting room kept me awake all night too.

cards.front: Los musulmanes rezando durante el Ramadán tampoco me dejaban dormir en toda la noche.
cards.back: Muslims praying during Ramadan also kept me awake all night.

cards.front: Ella estaba tan inquieta por su futuro dentro de la compañía que mantuvo su mente ocupada escribiendo cientos de informes.
cards.back: She was so uneasy about her future in the company that she kept her mind busy writing hundreds of reports.

cards.front: Ella estaba tan tensa por tener que hablar delante de 300 personas que su marido la mantuvo ocupada preparando magdalenas.
cards.back: She was so uptight about having to talk in front of 300 people that her husband kept her busy baking cupcakes.

cards.front: Ella estaba tan indignada porque él cancelara la boda que se mantuvo ocupada quemando las 500 invitaciones.
cards.back: She was so outraged about him calling off the wedding that she kept herself busy burning the 500 invitations.

cards.front: En el viaje hacia la casa de mis padres al sur de Inglaterra mantuvimos a los niños entretenidos jugando al Veo veo.
cards.back: On the trip to my parents' house in the south of England we kept our children amused by playing I spy.

cards.front: En el viaje hacia la casa de la playa de Tim y Lisa en el norte de Francia mantuvieron entretenidos a sus sobrinos jugando a Piedra, papel o tijera.
cards.back: On the trip to Tim and Lisa's beach house in the north of France they kept their nephew and niece amused by playing Rock, Paper, Scissors.

cards.front: En el viaje hacia el parque de atracciones al este de la ciudad él mantuvo a sus nietos entretenidos jugando a La lista de la compra.
cards.back: On the trip to the amusement park in the east of the city he kept his grandchild entertained by playing The Grocery Game.

cards.front: Le pedimos a Lisa que nos mantuviera informados de todos los detalles sobre la boda de David Beckham.
cards.back: We asked Lisa to keep us posted of all the details concerning David Beckham's wedding.

cards.front: Ella prometió que nos iba a mantener informados.
cards.back: She promised she was going to keep us informed.

cards.front: Sin embargo, nos mantuvo en suspense todo el fin de semana.
cards.back: However, she kept us in suspense the whole weekend.

cards.front: Le dije a Tim que jugaría al Veo veo con él si mantenía su cuarto limpio.
cards.back: I told Tim I would play I spy with him if he kept his bedroom clean.

cards.front: Me dijo que mantendría su cuarto limpio si jugaba al Veo veo y a Piedra, papel y tijera con él.
cards.back: He said he would keep it clean if I played I spy and Rock, Paper, Scissors with him.

cards.front: Le prometí que jugaría con él al Veo veo, a Piedra, papel y tijera y al Escondite si lo mantenía limpio y ordenado.
cards.back: I promised I would play I spy, Rock, Paper, Scissors and Hide and seek with him if he kept it clean and tidy.

cards.front: ¿Te resulta fácil o difícil guardar un secreto?
cards.back: Do you find it hard or easy to keep a secret?

cards.front: Él consideró vital mantener en secreto su nuevo invento.
cards.back: He considered it vital to keep secret his new invention.

cards.front: El entrenador del Manchester United mantuvo en secreto hasta el último minuto los once jugadores que iban a jugar ese día.
cards.back: The Manchester United manager kept the eleven players who were going to play that day secret until the last minute.

cards.front: La secretaria tomó nota de todo lo que se dijo en la reunión.
cards.back: The secretary kept a record of everything that was mentioned in the meeting.

cards.front: Cuando era joven escribía un diario, pero con la vida ajetreada de hoy en día es difícil escribir uno.
cards.back: I kept a diary when I was young, but with today's busy lifestyle it's hard to keep one.

cards.front: Escribir un diario te ayuda a recordar algunas de las mejores y peores experiencias de tu vida.
cards.back: Keeping a diary helps you keep track of some of your best and worst life experiences.

cards.front: Es la tercera vez este mes que no acudes a tu cita con el ginecólogo.
cards.back: It's the third time this month you haven't kept your appointment with the gynaecologist.

cards.front: Él llamó a la clínica para hacerles saber que no iba a poder acudir a su cita con el urólogo.
cards.back: He called the doctor's surgery to let them know he wasn't going to be able to keep his appointment with the urologist.

cards.front: Ella acudió a su cita con el endocrino el lunes pasado.
cards.back: She kept her appointment with the endocrinologist last Monday.

cards.front: No te fíes de ella, no puede cumplir una promesa.
cards.back: Don't trust her, she can't keep a promise.

cards.front: En ese caso, no entiendo por qué hace promesas si no puede cumplirlas.
cards.back: In that case, I don't know why she makes promises if she can't keep them.

cards.front: Ella me prometió que lo haría, tenía la intención de cumplir su promesa, pero finalmente la rompió.
cards.back: She promised me she would do it, intended to keep her promise, but eventually broke it.

cards.front: No te fíes de ella, no puede cumplir su palabra.
cards.back: Don't trust her, she can't keep her word.

cards.front: En ese caso, no entiendo por qué hace promesas si no puede mantener su palabra.
cards.back: In that case, I don't know why she makes promises if she can't keep her word.

cards.front: Ella me prometió que lo haría, pero no cumplió su palabra.
cards.back: She promised me she would do it, but didn't keep her word.

cards.front: No hago más que pensar que hoy es sábado y mañana domingo.
cards.back: I keep thinking that today is Saturday and tomorrow is Sunday.

cards.front: ¿Cómo es que sigues pensando que hoy es sábado si estás trabajando en la oficina?
cards.back: How come you keep thinking today is Saturday if you are working in the office?

cards.front: Sigamos pensando en cómo transformar estos problemas en soluciones.
cards.back: Let's keep thinking about how to turn these problems into solutions.

cards.front: Siempre se me olvida dónde deja mi mujer las llaves del coche.
cards.back: I keep forgetting where my wife puts the car keys.

cards.front: ¿Cómo es que siempre se te olvida dónde deja tu mujer las llaves del coche si lleváis casados veinte años?
cards.back: How come you keep forgetting where she puts the car keys if you've been married for 20 years?

cards.front: Se me olvidaba todo el rato hacer una foto de la vista que había desde la ventana de mi hotel y al final me fui de Bunny sin hacerla.
cards.back: I kept forgetting to take a photo of the view from my hotel window and left Bunny without taking it.

cards.front: Tom no para de decirle a Alan que no hable con la boca llena.
cards.back: Tom keeps telling Alan not to talk with his mouth full.

cards.front: Alan no para de decirle a Tom que no le diga lo que tiene que hacer.
cards.back: Alan keeps telling Tom not to tell him what he has to do.

cards.front: Yo no paro de decirles a los dos que dejen de decirse el uno al otro lo que tienen que hacer.
cards.back: I keep telling both of them to stop telling each other what to do.

cards.front: Estaba desolada después de la muerte de su marido, pero siguió luchando para sacar a sus hijos adelante.
cards.back: She was devastated after her husband's death, but kept going to give her children a good start in life.

cards.front: Él pensó en dejar el régimen, pero siguió adelante y adelgazó 40 kilos en ocho meses.
cards.back: He thought about giving up his diet, but kept going and lost 40 kilos in eight months.

cards.front: Tuvieron ganas de abandonar, pero siguieron adelante y llegaron a la cima de la montaña.
cards.back: They felt like quitting, but kept going and got to the summit of the mountain.

cards.front: Pam se tomó unas tortitas de maíz para permitirle seguir hasta la hora de la comida.
cards.back: Pam had some corn biscuits to keep her going until lunch time.

cards.front: Decidieron cerrar la biblioteca de la ciudad porque no podían permitirse seguir adelante.
cards.back: They decided to close the city library down because they couldn't afford to keep it going.

cards.front: Sam pidió un préstamo al banco para sacar adelante su granja.
cards.back: Sam asked the bank for a loan to keep his farm going.

cards.front: ¿Qué es lo que más les preocupa a los padres y no les deja dormir por la noche?
cards.back: What troubles parents the most and keeps them up at night?

cards.front: La seguridad y el futuro de sus hijos son lo que más les preocupa a los padres y lo que no les deja dormir por la noche.
cards.back: Their children's security and future troubles parents the most and keeps them up at night.

cards.front: Cuando era pequeña, suspender todos los exámenes era lo que más me preocupaba y no me dejaba dormir por la noche.
cards.back: When I was little, failing all my exams troubled me the most and kept me up at night.

cards.front: Intentaron mantener los salarios de los empleados, pero debido a la crisis tuvieron que bajarlos.
cards.back: They tried to keep the employees' wages high, but due to the crisis they had to lower them.

cards.front: Si mantienen los precios de la gasolina tan altos no podremos permitírnosla.
cards.back: If they keep petrol prices high we won't be able to afford it.

cards.front: Si las tiendas mantienen esos precios tan altos nadie va a comprar nada.
cards.back: If shops keep their prices high, nobody is going to buy anything.

cards.front: Tuve que caminar deprisa para poder seguirle.
cards.back: I had to walk fast to keep up with him.

cards.front: A Jack le está costando mantenerse al mismo nivel que el resto de la clase.
cards.back: Jack's having trouble keeping up with the rest of the class.

cards.front: Pusieron su casa en venta porque no podían seguir con los pagos de la hipoteca.
cards.back: They put their house up for sale because they couldn't keep up with the mortgage payments.

cards.front: Intento ver la tele y escuchar la radio a diario para mantenerme al corriente de lo que está ocurriendo.
cards.back: I try to watch the TV and listen to the radio on a daily basis to keep up with the latest news.

cards.front: ¿Qué es lo que haces para mantenerte al tanto de los temas de actualidad?
cards.back: What do you do to keep up to date with current affairs?

cards.front: Los empleados que quieren llegar lejos necesitan mantenerse al día sobre los últimos desarrollos en su campo.
cards.back: Employees who want to progress in their careers need to keep up with the latest developments in their field.

cards.front: Los soldados cantaban mientras desfilaban para mantener el espíritu alegre.
cards.back: The soldiers sang as they marched to keep their spirits up.

cards.front: Intenta comer alimentos ricos en hierro y vitaminas para mantenerte fuerte.
cards.back: Try and eat food rich in iron and vitamins to keep your strength up.

cards.front: Ella siempre intenta mantener alta la moral del equipo.
cards.back: She always tries to keep the team's morale up.

cards.front: No pude evitar reírme cuando me lo contaron.
cards.back: I couldn't keep from laughing when they told me about it.

cards.front: Ella evitó decirle la verdad porque le daba miedo su reacción.
cards.back: She kept from telling him the truth because she was afraid of his reaction.

cards.front: No dejaré de comer comida basura hasta principios del mes que viene.
cards.back: I won't keep from eating fast food until the beginning of next month.

cards.front: Rosario no pudo evitar llorar al ver el final de Titanic.
cards.back: Rosario couldn't keep from crying after seeing the end of Titanic.

cards.front: Ella no pudo evitar toser en el auditorio.
cards.back: She couldn't keep from coughing in the auditorium.

cards.front: Ella tenía tanto frío que no pudo evitar temblar.
cards.back: She was so cold that she couldn't keep from shaking.

cards.front: Si quieres hacer que Lucas no ladre, ¡dale de comer!
cards.back: If you want to keep Lucas from barking, feed him!

cards.front: La presentadora no pudo evitar que la audiencia abuchease.
cards.back: The presenter couldn't keep the audience from booing.

cards.front: ¿Cómo puedes hacer que un canguro no salte?
cards.back: How do you keep a kangaroo from jumping?

cards.front: El gobierno no reveló la verdad al público.
cards.back: The government kept the truth from the general population.

cards.front: ¿Te has preguntado alguna vez cuántas cosas te han escondido últimamente?
cards.back: Have you ever wondered how many things have been kept from you recently?

cards.front: ¡Mi novio me está ocultando algo! ¡Lo puedo sentir en los huesos!
cards.back: My boyfriend is keeping something from me! I can feel it!

cards.front: ¡No dejes que su negatividad haga que no te lo pases bien!
cards.back: Don't let their negativity keep you from enjoying yourself!

cards.front: No dejaré que mi brazo roto haga que no disfrute del verano.
cards.back: I won't let my broken arm keep me from enjoying the summer.

cards.front: No permitas que yo no te deje terminar tu trabajo. Sé que tienes una fecha tope.
cards.back: Don't let me keep you from finishing your work. I know you have a deadline.

cards.front: ¡No pisar la hierba!
cards.back: Keep off the grass!

cards.front: ¡No pises la alfombra nueva! ¡Me costó un ojo de la cara!
cards.back: Keep off the new rug! It cost me an arm and a leg!

cards.front: ¡No pises mi terreno o llamaré la policía!
cards.back: Keep off my land or I'll call the police!

cards.front: ¡Prohibido el paso a la sala de máquinas! Es muy peligroso estar allí dentro.
cards.back: Keep out of the engine room! It's very dangerous in there.

cards.front: No entres en la casa abandonada y en ruinas. Podrías tener un accidente.
cards.back: Keep out of the derelict house. You could have an accident.

cards.front: No entres en la cocina. Lo que te estoy cocinando es una sorpresa.
cards.back: Keep out of the kitchen. What I'm cooking you is a surprise.

cards.front: ¡No te acerques al borde del acantilado!
cards.back: Keep away from the edge of the cliff!

cards.front: ¡No te acerques a mi hija!
cards.back: Keep away from my daughter!

cards.front: ¡No te acerques al río! ¡Hay hipopótamos asesinos por allí!
cards.back: Keep away from the river! There are killer hippopotamuses around there!

cards.front: ¡Manteneos alejados! Hay un incendio.
cards.back: Keep back! There's a fire.

cards.front: ¡Manténganse alejados! Va a haber una explosión.
cards.back: Keep back! There's going to be an explosion.

cards.front: ¡Manténganse alejados! El géiser está a punto de entrar en erupción.
cards.back: Keep back! The geyser's about to erupt!

cards.front: ¡Agachaos! ¡Él tiene un arma!
cards.back: Keep down! He's got a gun!

cards.front: ¡Agáchense! ¡Están lanzando piedras!
cards.back: Keep down! They're throwing stones!

cards.front: ¡Agáchate o nos verán!
cards.back: Keep down or they'll see us!
